viewportcam.option.bodyFollowsCamera.des: The player entity follows the camera; singleplayer creative only
viewportcam.option.clickDragThreshold.de: A drag counts only past this many pixels
viewportcam.option.clientBlockReach.desc: Client-side block interaction distance; -1 = vanilla default
viewportcam.option.clientEntityReach.des: Client-side entity interaction distance; -1 = vanilla default
viewportcam.option.scaleSensitivity.desc: Wheel sensitivity for the camera distance to the pivot
viewportcam.option.flightDecel.desc: Time to come to a stop
viewportcam.option.mouseMode.desc.alt_ho: Hold: hold the modifier to control the camera; release to exit
viewportcam.option.mouseMode.desc.alt_to: Toggle: press the modifier to control the camera; press again to exit
viewportcam.option.mouseMode.desc.hybrid: Hybrid: rotate/pan and break/place share the buttons; break/place fires on release, so it cannot repeat
viewportcam.option.mouseMode.desc.indepe: Independent: rotate/pan bound to their own buttons work alongside break/place; the wheel still needs the modifier
viewportcam.option.panSmoothing.desc: Damping strength for how the pivot follows the mouse
viewportcam.option.rotateSmoothing.desc: Damping strength for how the camera follows the mouse
viewportcam.option.showPivotOutline.desc: Draw a wireframe on the block at the viewport pivot
viewportcam.option.singleplayerServerRea: Sync the reach above to the integrated server; singleplayer with cheats only
viewportcam.option.sprintHorizontalMulti: Horizontal speed multiplier while Ctrl (sprint) is held
viewportcam.option.sprintVerticalMultipl: Vertical speed multiplier while Ctrl (sprint) is held
viewportcam.option.zoomTrackAnchor.desc: Keep the camera locked onto the anchored block
viewportcam.status.camera: LMB rotate / RMB pan / wheel zoom
viewportcam.status.crosshair: Hold Alt to control the camera
viewportcam.status.hybrid: Click: break/place. Drag: rotate/pan. Alt+wheel: zoom
viewportcam.title: ViewportCam
